design.input_contract: weight 1; n commands; positive lengths 1..40; negative arrival PID; no input zero or appended terminator
design.metric_blindness: No placements, addresses, solver executions, scores, performance feedback, rejection or resampling. Choices depend only on generated objects, phase and seeded randomness.
design.missing_preferred_group: Choose a uniform active object if a preferred group is empty; FIFO/LIFO/deadline modes retain their named fallback where supplied.
design.occupancy: Report live volume/count, peak volume/count and ceil(live_volume/20), a volume lower bound independent of placement. Preserve and mark zero-final-volume cases; never filter them.
design.purpose: Independent local comparison on new temporal mechanisms; not an estimate of an unknown hidden-test distribution.
design.rep_assignment: rep 0,1,2,3 takes the corresponding fixed length; one independent secrets seed per base

seed_derivation: independent secrets.token_hex(32) per base; master is provenance entropy, not a derivation key
